name: Jae Min
psychographics: Cautious spender who values efficiency; prefers cooking in bulk to avoid the 'decision fatigue' of daily meals.
current_solutions: Uses the SSG (Supermarket Service Grocery) app for bulk rice and kimchi; splits the bill via KakaoPay with roommates.
frustration: Last Friday at 11:00pm, the SSG app failed to process his payment, leaving his cart of frozen dumplings stuck in 'pending' for two hours until he called customer service.
decision_style: Checks Naver review scores; only buys items with 4.5 stars or higher to avoid waste.
voice: Formal and measured; switches to casual slang only when texting close friends about food trends.
